description.zh: 优化平板布局、液态导航、页面动效和会话管理，并统一 Starlore 晴空背景。
description.en: Refines tablet layouts, liquid navigation, page motion and chat history, with a unified Starlore sky background.

zh.title: 新增
items: 新增独立会话记录页面，支持新建、切换和侧滑删除会话
新增统一页面动效、回弹滚动和二级页面交互规范

zh.title: 优化
items: 优化平板端页面布局与弹窗尺寸
优化底部液态玻璃导航的拖动与选中反馈
统一会话记录进入退出动画与系统返回行为
将马卡龙背景更新为与网页端一致的晴空柔光背景

en.title: New
items: Dedicated chat history page with session creation, switching and swipe-to-delete
Shared page motion, elastic scrolling and secondary-page interaction patterns

en.title: Improved
items: Refined tablet layouts and dialog sizing
Improved liquid-glass bottom navigation dragging and selection feedback
Aligned chat-history transitions with system back behavior
Replaced the macaron blend with the web-aligned Starlore sky glow
